text.arabic_uthmani: الٓر ۚ كِتَٰبٌ أَنزَلْنَٰهُ إِلَيْكَ لِتُخْرِجَ ٱلنَّاسَ مِنَ ٱلظُّلُمَٰتِ إِلَى ٱلنُّورِ بِإِذْنِ رَبِّهِمْ إِلَىٰ صِرَٰطِ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْحَمِيدِ

words.gloss_range: disconnected recited letters before ordinary clause grammar begins

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the following Book declaration after the letter opener

words.prose: {{ar:الٓر}} ({{tr:alif-lām-rā}}) opens as recited letter-names, not as a parsed word inside the Book clause. The pause and separated recitation make the opening an audible threshold before {{ar:كِتَٰبٌ}} ({{tr:kitābun}}), while the exact three-letter formula places the surah among the {{ar:الٓر}} ({{tr:alif-lām-rā}}) openings (10:1; 11:1; 12:1; 15:1).

topics.headline: pre-grammatical letter threshold
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the surah begins with recited letters before normal syntax and lexical meaning begin.
topics.reason: QAC identifies the opener as disconnected letters with no root or morphological parse, and attachment evidence starts the nominal Book clause after the opener.

topics.headline: audible separated onset
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the threshold as separated letter-names with a measured cadence, not as a fused lexical item.
topics.reason: The rows about pause, separated letter reading, and cadence cohere with the non-lexical parse.

topics.headline: shared opener formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that this opening belongs to a recurring revelation-opening family while this ayah immediately specializes it with a Book-and-purpose declaration.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows give concrete same-form opener links to 10:1, 11:1, 12:1, and 15:1.

words.gloss_range: magnified revealed Book, record, and decree rather than an ordinary document
words.root_gloss_range: writing, inscribing, prescribing, decreeing, and binding into an ordered whole
words.prose: {{ar:كِتَٰبٌ}} ({{tr:kitābun}}) stands as the first parsed declaration: a Book, left indefinite for magnification, then identified by the descent clause. The root pressure keeps writing, decree, and binding together, so the Book is not a loose message but an ordered revealed record whose purpose will be extraction.

topics.headline: nominal magnified Book
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the first parsed claim presents a magnified Book before any finite main verb drives the sentence.
topics.reason: QAC marks {{ar:كِتَٰبٌ}} ({{tr:kitābun}}) as an indefinite nominative noun in the opening nominal clause, and attachment evidence treats it as the head qualified by the following descent clause.

topics.headline: scripture, decree, and binding
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that Book language carries written, prescriptive, and ordered-binding force, while the local context selects revealed scripture rather than an ordinary document.
topics.reason: The broader root field is valid as pressure, but the following {{ar:أَنزَلْنَٰهُ}} ({{tr:anzalnāhu}}) and purpose clause narrow the local referent to revealed scripture-decree.

topics.headline: Book and descent pairing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that writing and sending-down form the ayah's conceptual unit, not two unrelated details.
topics.reason: The pronoun in the next word resumes the Book, and the CRITICAL collocation rows identify the k-t-b and n-z-l pairing as a major revelation pattern.

words.gloss_range: divinely caused sending down of the Book to the addressee
words.root_gloss_range: descending, alighting, arriving, settling, and provisioned coming-down; local Form IV makes it caused descent

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: first-person plural speaker element inside the descent verb
third-person masculine object suffix returning to the Book

words.prose: {{ar:أَنزَلْنَٰهُ}} ({{tr:anzalnāhu}}) compresses the sender and the sent object into one completed descent verb: {{ar:نَا}} ({{tr:nā}}) marks the divine speaker and {{ar:هُ}} ({{tr:hu}}) returns to the Book. Form IV makes the descent caused, and the root's arrival-and-settlement range lets revelation feel delivered to a determinate addressee before the purpose clause begins. This directed reception also sets up the later sending-down of provision at 14:32.

topics.headline: caused descent with bound object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that divine agency and the Book-object are built into the verb form itself.
topics.reason: QAC identifies a Form IV perfect with first-plural subject and third-masculine object suffix, and attachment evidence links the suffix back to {{ar:كِتَٰبٌ}} ({{tr:kitābun}}).

topics.headline: whole arrival, not autonomous descent
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices revelation as a caused arrival and settling of the Book as a whole, while the morphology blocks treating it as self-descending.
topics.reason: The settlement and staged-descent contrasts are useful root pressure, but local Form IV selects caused sending down by the divine speaker.

topics.headline: directed reception and later provision echo
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that this descent is framed as direct arrival to the addressee, and the surah later echoes sending-down through provision (14:32).
topics.reason: {{ar:إِلَيْكَ}} ({{tr:ilayka}}) supplies the reception endpoint, while the CRITICAL rows contrast other reception frames such as 18:1 and note same-surah n-z-l uptake at 14:32.

words.gloss_range: directional endpoint to the singular addressee
words.prose: {{ar:إِلَيْكَ}} ({{tr:ilayka}}) turns the descent into direct address. The preposition marks an endpoint, and the bound {{ar:كَ}} ({{tr:ka}}) makes the recipient present without naming him; the Book arrives to this addressee before the next verb gives him the extraction mission. That addressed mission then gives way to the ownership-and-woe frame of 14:2.

topics.headline: singular addressed recipient
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the shift from Book-description into direct second-person address.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence identify {{ar:إِلَيْكَ}} ({{tr:ilayka}}) as a directional preposition with a second masculine singular suffix attached to the descent verb.

topics.headline: arrival endpoint, not imposition
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that reception is pictured as directed arrival to an endpoint rather than descent onto a surface.
topics.reason: The local preposition is {{ar:إِلَى}} ({{tr:ilā}}), and the CRITICAL rows contrast this endpoint frame with the different {{ar:عَلَى}} ({{tr:ʿalā}}) reception frame in 18:1.

topics.headline: mission before cosmic frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that direct address in 14:1 precedes the move to ownership and woe in 14:2.
topics.reason: The boundary row gives a concrete next-ayah contrast, with 14:2 shifting from addressed mission into cosmic possession and judgment.

words.gloss_range: purposive lām governing the following subjunctive verb

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the following subjunctive extraction verb governed by the purposive particle

words.prose: {{ar:لِ}} ({{tr:li}}) is the hinge from revelation report to mission purpose. Because it governs the subjunctive {{ar:تُخْرِجَ}} ({{tr:tukhrija}}), it makes extraction the reason the Book is sent, not merely a later effect or a possession claim.

topics.headline: purpose hinge into extraction
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the Book's descent is grammatically aimed at extraction.
topics.reason: QAC marks the particle as purposive and attachment evidence makes the following clause subordinate to the sending-down clause.

topics.headline: clitic tied to subjunctive verb
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that purpose is fused directly onto the extraction verb's onset.
topics.reason: The proclitic particle attaches to {{ar:تُخْرِجَ}} ({{tr:tukhrija}}), whose subjunctive form selects purposive force over other possible lām values.

words.gloss_range: to cause people to come out as the intended purpose of revelation
words.root_gloss_range: going out, emerging, being brought out, producing, and related levy/outflow senses; local Form IV selects causative extraction
words.prose: {{ar:تُخْرِجَ}} ({{tr:tukhrija}}) names the Book's purpose as a causative act: the addressee is to bring people out. The subjunctive keeps this as intended outcome, while the root's emergence and sprouting pressure makes guidance feel like real release from a containing state; variant evidence can picture emergence, but the local canonical grammar assigns causative agency to the addressed recipient. The same extraction formula is echoed in 2:257 and 14:5, and it is reversed as an expulsion-threat in 14:13.

topics.headline: subjunctive purpose extraction
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that extraction is the intended function of revelation, not a completed event inside the ayah.
topics.reason: QAC marks the verb as Form IV imperfect subjunctive governed by the purposive particle, and attachment evidence places the purpose clause under the descent clause.

topics.headline: causative agency with emergence variant
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the canonical form gives the addressee a causative extraction role, while the variant contrast highlights emergence without overriding that parse.
topics.reason: The local QAC form is transitive Form IV with {{ar:ٱلنَّاسَ}} ({{tr:al-nās}}) as object, so the intransitive variant is useful contrast rather than the governing parse.

topics.headline: emergence image and formula echoes
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices extraction as an emergence from enclosure, and sees the darkness-to-light mission recur in formula and same-surah command scenes (2:257; 14:5; 14:13).
topics.reason: The emergence and sprouting field is valid root pressure, but local syntax keeps the sense to causing human extraction from darknesses into light.

words.gloss_range: the definite human collective as object of extraction
words.root_gloss_range: human sociality, familiarity, perception, and contested links with forgetfulness; local noun selects the human collective

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the later Lordship phrase with plural suffix returning to the people

words.prose: {{ar:ٱلنَّاسَ}} ({{tr:al-nāsa}}) is the definite collective object of the extraction verb. Its root pressure keeps social-perceptive humanity in view without making forgetfulness the local sense. Its position makes the human collective the hinge between causative mission and the from-to movement, and its later suffixal return in {{ar:رَبِّهِمْ}} ({{tr:rabbihim}}) ties the people being moved to the Lord whose permission authorizes the movement.

topics.headline: definite collective object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the mission targets the identifiable human collective, not an abstract condition alone.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence mark the word as definite accusative direct object of {{ar:تُخْرِجَ}} ({{tr:tukhrija}}); variant subject pressure is contrastive, not the local governing parse.

topics.headline: social-perceptive humanity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices humanity as a social-perceptive collective, while the local noun does not turn the ayah into a claim about forgetfulness alone.
topics.reason: The contested derivational pressure is meaningful, but local morphology and object role select the ordinary collective human referent.

topics.headline: human hinge to trajectory and Lordship
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the same people stand between extraction and trajectory and then reappear inside the authorization phrase through the plural suffix.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence links the plural suffix in {{ar:رَبِّهِمْ}} ({{tr:rabbihim}}) back to {{ar:ٱلنَّاسَ}} ({{tr:al-nās}}), and the CRITICAL rows track the same human-audience thread through the surah.

words.gloss_range: source and separation marker for the darknesses

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the first destination preposition answering the source marker

words.prose: {{ar:مِنَ}} ({{tr:mina}}) begins the trajectory by marking the darknesses as the source-container from which people are brought out. It does not merely decorate the noun; it creates the first half of the from-to movement that will be answered by {{ar:إِلَى}} ({{tr:ilā}}). The nasal onset also binds audibly into the following darkness word.

topics.headline: source-container marker
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that darknesses are treated as a containing source from which extraction occurs.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence governs {{ar:ٱلظُّلُمَٰتِ}} ({{tr:al-ẓulumāt}}) under {{ar:مِنَ}} ({{tr:min}}) as source of the extraction verb.

topics.headline: from-to trajectory onset
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah's movement begins with a marked source that prepares the light destination.
topics.reason: The particle participates in the syntactically forced source-goal sequence around {{ar:تُخْرِجَ}} ({{tr:tukhrija}}).

words.gloss_range: definite plural darknesses as the source-state of extraction
words.root_gloss_range: darkness, injustice, oppression, and misplacement; local plural noun selects darknesses with injustice/misplacement pressure

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the source preposition governing the darknesses
the singular light destination contrasted with plural darknesses

words.prose: {{ar:ٱلظُّلُمَٰتِ}} ({{tr:al-ẓulumāt}}) is the plural source-state under {{ar:مِنَ}} ({{tr:min}}). The plural sets many darknesses against the singular {{ar:ٱلنُّورِ}} ({{tr:al-nūr}}), while the root's injustice and misplacement field keeps the darkness from being only optical gloom; the ayah pictures exit from multiple disordered states into one light. The same darkness-light mission recurs in 2:257, 5:16, 14:5, 57:9, and 65:11, and the dense sound gives the darkness word heaviness before release.

topics.headline: plural source against singular light
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the asymmetry: many darknesses are left behind for one definite light.
topics.reason: QAC marks {{ar:ٱلظُّلُمَٰتِ}} ({{tr:al-ẓulumāt}}) as definite genitive plural under source {{ar:مِنَ}} ({{tr:min}}), contrasting with singular destination {{ar:ٱلنُّورِ}} ({{tr:al-nūr}}).

topics.headline: darkness with injustice pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the source-state evokes darkness as disorientation and misplacement, not only lack of physical light.
topics.reason: The injustice and misplacement branches are valid root pressure, but local noun form and antithesis select darknesses as the active lexical sense.

topics.headline: darkness-to-light formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices this phrase as a recurring revelation trajectory and as a same-surah mission formula (2:257; 5:16; 14:5; 57:9; 65:11).
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows give concrete darkness-to-light references and repeat the mission formula at 14:5.

topics.headline: dense sound and boundary handoff
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the heaviness and boundary pressure of the darkness word before the phrase releases toward light and later concealment agents.
topics.reason: The sound and boundary rows do not alter the parse but preserve a reader-facing recitational and discourse effect.

words.gloss_range: directional goal marker for the light destination

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the source preposition answered by the light-goal marker
the later repeated goal marker introducing the path

words.prose: {{ar:إِلَى}} ({{tr:ilā}}) answers {{ar:مِنَ}} ({{tr:min}}) by marking light as the goal endpoint. It also prepares the later repeated {{ar:إِلَىٰ}} ({{tr:ilā}}), so the ayah does not stop at movement out of darkness but keeps destination language open toward the specified path.

topics.headline: light as goal endpoint
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices light as the grammatical destination of extraction.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence governs {{ar:ٱلنُّورِ}} ({{tr:al-nūr}}) under this preposition as the destination of {{ar:تُخْرِجَ}} ({{tr:tukhrija}}).

topics.headline: matched directional slots
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the first destination slot preparing the second destination slot of the path.
topics.reason: The repeated preposition pattern creates coordinated destination grammar around light and path.

words.gloss_range: the definite singular light as the first destination of extraction
words.root_gloss_range: light, illumination, visibility, guidance, and nearby fire contrast; local noun selects light/guidance destination
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلنُّورِ}} ({{tr:al-nūr}}) is the singular definite destination after plural darknesses. Its root makes guidance perceptible and navigable, while the nearby fire contrast stays a hazard boundary rather than the selected sense; the phrase then opens further into the path, so light becomes destination and doorway. The same formula returns at 14:5 and its destination is reframed by divine-light language in 24:35; the open cadence releases after the denser darkness word.

topics.headline: one definite light destination
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices one definite light answering many darknesses.
topics.reason: QAC marks {{ar:ٱلنُّورِ}} ({{tr:al-nūr}}) as definite singular genitive governed by the destination preposition.

topics.headline: visible navigable guidance
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices guidance as visibility and navigation, while fire-root proximity remains contrastive rather than locally selected.
topics.reason: The local noun and darkness-light antithesis select light/guidance; the nūr-nār proximity usefully marks a hazard contrast without changing the referent.

topics.headline: formula light opening into path
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that light belongs to a recurring darkness-light formula and then opens toward a named path and cosmic frame (14:5; 24:35).
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows give formula recurrence at 14:5 and a divine-light echo at 24:35, while local syntax continues to a second destination phrase.

topics.headline: sound release after darkness
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the light word as a release after the denser darkness word.
topics.reason: The phonetic row preserves an audible payoff without altering the lexical parse.

words.gloss_range: instrumental and enabling preposition introducing authorization

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the authorization noun governed by the instrumental preposition

words.prose: {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}) attaches the extraction to authorization. By fusing onto {{ar:إِذْنِ}} ({{tr:idhni}}), it interrupts the movement from light to path with the condition that the mission works by permission, not by independent prophetic force.

topics.headline: permission as enabling means
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that extraction is enabled by permission rather than autonomous agency.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence attaches the bi-phrase to {{ar:تُخْرِجَ}} ({{tr:tukhrija}}) as an enabling or instrumental adjunct.

topics.headline: trajectory interrupted by condition
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the authorization phrase placed between the light destination and the path destination.
topics.reason: The particle is a proclitic on {{ar:إِذْنِ}} ({{tr:idhni}}), and the phrase sits before the second {{ar:إِلَىٰ}} ({{tr:ilā}}) destination.

words.gloss_range: authorization or permission as a genitive verbal noun in construct
words.root_gloss_range: permission, authorization, announcement, hearing, and ear imagery; local construct selects authorization

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the Lordship complement completing the authorization construct

words.prose: {{ar:إِذْنِ}} ({{tr:idhni}}) nominalizes authorization and places it in construct with {{ar:رَبِّهِمْ}} ({{tr:rabbihim}}). The hearing and ear imagery gives permission an auditory gateway feel, but the local grammar selects authorization as the condition that links extraction to the people's Lord. The same root later opens into proclamation at 14:7.

topics.headline: authorization sourced in Lordship
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices permission as a named condition sourced through the following Lordship construct.
topics.reason: QAC marks the word as a genitive gerund governed by {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}), and attachment evidence makes {{ar:رَبِّهِمْ}} ({{tr:rabbihim}}) its construct complement.

topics.headline: permission with hearing pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices permission as more than paperwork: the root also evokes hearing and announcement, while local syntax keeps authorization as the selected sense.
topics.reason: The hearing and ear branches are valid root pressure but do not override the bi-phrase authorization frame.

topics.headline: authorization between light and path
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices authorization interrupting the motion sequence between light and the divinely attributed path.
topics.reason: The phrase stands after {{ar:إِلَى ٱلنُّورِ}} ({{tr:ilā al-nūr}}) and before {{ar:إِلَىٰ صِرَٰطِ}} ({{tr:ilā ṣirāṭ}}), while still attaching to the extraction purpose clause.

topics.headline: permission to proclamation echo
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the authorization root later opening toward proclamation in the surah (14:7).
topics.reason: The same root has same-surah uptake at 14:7, where the authorization/hearing field becomes public announcement.

words.gloss_range: their Lord as relational possessor and nurturing authority in the authorization phrase
words.root_gloss_range: lordship, ownership, authority, nurturing, cultivating, increasing, and related ribā contrast; local construct selects relational Lordship

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the human collective resumed by the plural suffix

words.prose: {{ar:رَبِّهِمْ}} ({{tr:rabbihim}}) binds authorization to the Lord of the people being extracted. The suffix returns to {{ar:ٱلنَّاسَ}} ({{tr:al-nās}}), so Lordship is not an abstract title here; it is relational, nurturing authority over the very collective moved from darknesses toward light and path. The same Lordship thread runs through prayer and warning at 14:35-41, and 14:2 grounds this permission in total ownership.

topics.headline: Lordship bound to the people
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the Lord in the permission phrase is grammatically tied to the people being extracted.
topics.reason: QAC marks a construct noun with third-plural possessive suffix, and attachment evidence resolves the suffix back to {{ar:ٱلنَّاسَ}} ({{tr:al-nās}}).

topics.headline: nurturing authority, not static title
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices Lordship as active nurturing authority, while the permission context keeps the local sense from drifting into unrelated increase or usury branches.
topics.reason: The nurturing and ownership field fits the authorization phrase, but local construct and divine title usage block activating the economic ribā branch as a local sense.

topics.headline: Lordship links revelation and people
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the Lord as both source of sending-down and relational Lord of the people addressed across the surah (14:35-41).
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows connect r-b-b with revelation descent and track dense same-surah Lordship in prayer and warning contexts.

topics.headline: permission grounded in ownership
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that 14:2 grounds the permission formula in cosmic ownership.
topics.reason: The boundary row identifies 14:2 as the ontological grounding for the Lord who grants permission.

words.gloss_range: repeated directional marker introducing the path as refined destination
words.prose: {{ar:إِلَىٰ}} ({{tr:ilā}}) repeats the goal marker and shifts the governed noun from light to path. That repetition lets the path be read both as the next stage after light and as an explanation of what the light is, completing a telescoping chain from recipient, to light, to divinely attributed path.

topics.headline: second goal phrase
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah introduces the path as a second governed destination, not as a loose adjective after light.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence makes {{ar:صِرَٰطِ}} ({{tr:ṣirāṭi}}) the genitive complement of this repeated destination preposition.

topics.headline: apposition and sequence telescope
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that light and path can function as alias and sequence at once, giving the destination a telescoped structure.
topics.reason: The second {{ar:إِلَىٰ}} ({{tr:ilā}}) is grammatically clear but can be read as restating the light or moving beyond it to the path.

words.gloss_range: path or routed course as destination and construct head
words.root_gloss_range: path, traversable course, possible swallowing/absorbing image, and phonological variant pressure; local noun selects path

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the repeated destination preposition governing the path

words.prose: {{ar:صِرَٰطِ}} ({{tr:ṣirāṭi}}) is both the destination governed by {{ar:إِلَىٰ}} ({{tr:ilā}}) and the construct head defined by the divine epithets that follow. The possible swallowing image makes the path feel like an enclosing route that receives the traveler, while accepted sound variants keep the path stable in meaning but alive as a recitational pressure point. It also answers the path request of 1:6 and presses toward explicit naming in 14:2.

topics.headline: destination and construct head
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices one word doing double grammatical work: goal of movement and head of the divine-attribution chain.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks {{ar:صِرَٰطِ}} ({{tr:ṣirāṭi}}) as governed by {{ar:إِلَىٰ}} ({{tr:ilā}}) and as construct head before {{ar:ٱلْعَزِيزِ}} ({{tr:al-ʿazīz}}).

topics.headline: path as enclosing channel
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the path as a traversable channel that can receive the one brought into light, while the local sense remains path rather than literal swallowing.
topics.reason: The swallowing derivation is useful image pressure, but the local noun and governed-goal syntax select the path/course sense.

topics.headline: stable path with sound variation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that accepted recitation variation shifts the sound surface without changing the destination word's referent.
topics.reason: The rows preserve canonical sound variation around the path term while keeping the semantic referent stable.

topics.headline: path answer and boundary resolution
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the path answering the request of 1:6 and pressing forward to explicit divine-name resolution in 14:2.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows link this path to 1:6 and note that 14:2 can complete the referential chain after the ayah boundary.

words.gloss_range: the definite divine epithet of might, invincibility, rarity, and preciousness in the path construct
words.root_gloss_range: strength, invincibility, rarity, preciousness, difficulty of access, and intensification; local divine epithet selects mighty and uniquely precious

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the paired praise epithet following the might epithet

words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْعَزِيزِ}} ({{tr:al-ʿazīz}}) fixes the path to a definite divine attribute, not to generic strength. The root field makes the path unassailable and uniquely precious, and the pairing with {{ar:ٱلْحَمِيدِ}} ({{tr:al-ḥamīd}}) steers power toward praiseworthiness rather than the more common wisdom pairing. Later power contexts in 14:4, 14:20, and 14:47 hear against this opening attribution.

topics.headline: definite genitive path attribute
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices divine might grammatically attached to the path rather than left as a detached closing title.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence makes {{ar:ٱلْعَزِيزِ}} ({{tr:al-ʿazīz}}) the genitive complement completing the {{ar:صِرَٰطِ}} ({{tr:ṣirāṭi}}) construct.

topics.headline: might with rarity and preciousness
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the path's power is also uniqueness and precious inaccessibility, not bare force.
topics.reason: The broader root field of strength, rarity, and preciousness coheres with the divine epithet and path attribution.

topics.headline: stable invincibility in form and sound
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the epithet presenting might as a stable quality with compact doubled-z force.
topics.reason: The faʿīl pattern and geminated root sound support stable and compact force without changing the syntactic relation.

topics.headline: rare power-praise pairing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that this ayah links might with praise rather than the common wisdom pairing, and sets up later power contrasts in the surah (14:4; 14:20; 14:47).
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows identify the rarer {{ar:ٱلْعَزِيزِ}} ({{tr:al-ʿazīz}}) and {{ar:ٱلْحَمِيدِ}} ({{tr:al-ḥamīd}}) pair and concrete same-surah power echoes.

words.gloss_range: the definite divine epithet of intrinsic praiseworthiness closing the ayah
words.root_gloss_range: praise, praiseworthiness, truthful commendation, active praising and being praised; local epithet selects the praised and praiseworthy divine name
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْحَمِيدِ}} ({{tr:al-ḥamīd}}) closes the ayah by making the path's power praiseworthy. Its faʿīl form can hold active and passive praise pressure, and the ending functions as a seal while still leaving the divine-name chain open to the boundary reading into 14:2. The rare pair appears with this force at 11:73, 14:1, and 85:8, and the word also anticipates praise at 14:39.

topics.headline: genitive closing epithet
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the final epithet completing the path attribution by landing divine might on praise.
topics.reason: QAC marks the word as a definite genitive divine attribute following {{ar:ٱلْعَزِيزِ}} ({{tr:al-ʿazīz}}), and attachment evidence licenses it as an attribute in the closing chain.

topics.headline: intrinsic active-passive praise
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices praise as inherent praiseworthiness and praise-source, not only gratitude after rescue.
topics.reason: The faʿīl morphology and root semantics support praised and praiseworthy force in the divine epithet.

topics.headline: rare might-praise formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the rare pairing of might with praise as the character of the path (11:73; 14:1; 85:8).
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows identify this divine-name pair as rare and specifically attested at 11:73, 14:1, and 85:8.

topics.headline: closure, echo, and boundary hinge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the final word sealing 14:1, anticipating later praise in 14:39, and staying syntactically open to 14:2 in variant boundary readings.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows give later ḥ-m-d uptake at 14:39 and boundary evidence where the next divine name can continue or restart the construction in 14:2.

topics.headline: final resonant cadence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the final long īd cadence as a resonant ayah seal.
topics.reason: The closing sound row gives an audible payoff while the grammar remains the genitive divine-attribute chain.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The purpose construction links the sent-down Book to causing people to pass from plural darknesses into light and then toward a path.
baseline_models.mechanism: An ordered communication is delivered to a commissioned recipient and becomes an instrument of outward transfer. Darkness supplies blocked or withheld conditions, light supplies disclosure, and the path converts disclosure into directed travel.

activation_trace.role: Written, ordered wording supplies the transferable instrument.
Delivery from sender to recipient installs that instrument with the messenger.
Outward passage makes guidance a transfer from a containing condition.
Withholding and blockage give the darknesses a functional rather than merely visual force.
Illumination supplies the disclosed destination.
The straight road turns visibility into oriented movement.

changed_reading.after: The Book commissions a directional transfer from blocked, obscured conditions into disclosed and traversable orientation.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence joins Book, placement by descent, emergence from hiddenness, the people's Lord, and a visible road marker.
baseline_models.mechanism: Joined elements are put in their proper station and used to bring what is hidden into view. The Lord's gradual repair and completion makes the process formative: revelation reorders and matures people until a route becomes legible.

activation_trace.role: Joining one element to another makes the Book an integrating composition.
Putting something in its fitting station supplies the reordering operation.
Bringing a thing out of concealment, including a learner from ignorance, supplies disclosure through formation.
Repair, nurture, and completion make the governing relation developmental.
A visible road marker makes successful formation navigable.

changed_reading.before: Light is information that replaces ignorance.
changed_reading.after: Light is the legibility produced when a joined communication is properly placed within a Lord-directed process of repair, maturation, and emergence.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The Book, the messenger's purpose, the Lord's permission, and the path of the Mighty and Praiseworthy form a bounded chain of authority.
baseline_models.mechanism: A binding record is executed through delegated authorization rather than autonomous messenger power. Lordship owns and governs the operation; might secures it, while the praiseworthy goal constrains what the power is for.

activation_trace.role: A written determination that obligates or fixes judgment supplies the mandate.
Permission and authorization delimit the messenger's effective agency.
Ownership and governing lordship locate the authority behind the commission.
Strength and inviolability secure the path against rival jurisdiction.
A praiseworthy culmination gives delegated power its evaluative end.

changed_reading.before: The messenger independently leads people toward God.
changed_reading.after: The messenger executes a bounded commission whose authority belongs to the people's Lord and whose force is answerable to a praiseworthy end.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context turns darkness into an engineered path condition: travelers are diverted from an extended route, its bend is actively sought, and the result is distant wandering. Light therefore includes restoration of route geometry, not only addition of information.

activation_trace.role: The focus road anchors the model in a traversable straight course.
Turning away and diverting supplies active obstruction of travel.
An extended path supplies the route being obstructed.
Seeking makes crookedness an intended modification rather than an accidental defect.
Deviation from straightness supplies the altered geometry.
Loss of the intended direction supplies the downstream state.

structural_cues: 14:3 coordinates diversion 'from the path' with seeking that same path as crooked.
The final 'distant' condition spatializes the consequence of the sabotage.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies obstruction, a path, intentional bending, and wandering; I infer that these operations specify one mechanism of the focus darknesses. A live alternative is that 14:3 only describes opposition to the path and does not define darkness itself.

changed_reading.before: Darkness is a passive lack of guidance.
changed_reading.after: Darkness can be maintained by redirecting travelers and deforming the route, so illumination also repairs orientation.

context_deltas.mechanism: Extraction proceeds through locally intelligible clarification, lacks an independently coercive proof-power, and reaches people as a call that can be answered. Authorization governs the communication without erasing recipient response.

activation_trace.role: Bringing something out of concealment anchors extraction in disclosure.
A people's language supplies the shared medium of the operation.
Clarifying meaning by speech or sign supplies communicative disclosure.
A compelling proof is explicitly unavailable to the messengers on their own.
Permission bounds any effective sign or authority.
Calling by speech supplies a non-coercive initiating act.
Answering speech supplies the recipient-side completion of the call.
Delivery of a message identifies the surah's closing communicative function.

structural_cues: 14:4 makes clarification the purpose of sending in each people's language.
14:11 repeats 'except by God's permission' around the requested authority.
14:22 contrasts mere calling with the hearers' answering, and 14:52 closes with a communication for people.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies intelligible speech, clarification, bounded authority, call, response, and delivered message; I infer a communicative causal chain for the focus extraction. A live alternative is that divine guidance remains decisive and the call-response sequence only allocates blame.

changed_reading.before: Authorized messenger power pulls people into light.
changed_reading.after: Authorized extraction normally works by making meaning reach people in an intelligible form and by eliciting an answer for which recipients remain responsible.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus formula is reenacted for a concrete people and then unpacked as rescue from imposed torment and selective killing. Remembering marked days preserves the liberation, while announced divine commitment links grateful recognition to continued increase.

activation_trace.role: Withholding and confinement anchor darkness in blocked human rights.
The repeated causative exit instantiates the focus commission for a named community.
A reminder that makes the past present supplies the preservation mechanism.
Rescue by separation gives the exit a concrete emancipatory form.
Imposed evil supplies the regime-like pressure from which rescue occurs.
Slitting for slaughter supplies the bodily extremity of the oppressive condition.
Announced self-commitment makes permission active determination rather than passive allowance.
A small received good whose effect becomes visible supplies the continuation of liberation through gratitude.

structural_cues: 14:5 repeats the focus darkness-to-light purpose almost verbatim but replaces all people with a particular people.
14:6 immediately names rescue, imposed punishment, slaughter, and selective preservation.
14:7 turns the permission root into an announced conditional commitment.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an exact reprise followed by oppression, rescue, memory, and increase; I infer that the concrete sequence activates a social-political layer in 14:1. A live alternative is that the Moses sequence is one analogy and not an exhaustive definition of the general commission.

changed_reading.before: Darkness and light chiefly describe belief and knowledge.
changed_reading.after: They can also name organized domination and collective emancipation, with memory and gratitude keeping the achieved exit operative.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same surah presents coercive expulsion, forced return, authorized entry into enduring peace, and leaders settling their people in ruin. Movement is not self-validating; its source, destination, authorization, and resulting habitation determine whether it liberates.

activation_trace.role: The focus outward passage anchors the morally positive commission.
The same outward passage is weaponized as threatened exile.
Return after departure supplies the coercive alternative to expulsion.
An adhered creed supplies the demanded destination of the forced return.
Entry into an interior supplies the positive completion of prior exit.
The focus authorization formula recurs at the destination threshold.
Safety from harm supplies the quality of the resulting habitation.
Causing a people to settle supplies a rival leadership operation.
Ruin and corruption identify the rival operation by its destination.

structural_cues: 14:13 places threatened expulsion and return to a creed as alternatives.
14:23 repeats 'by permission of their Lord' at entry into enduring gardens.
14:28 attributes settlement in the abode of ruin to leaders acting on their people.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies contrasting exits, returns, entries, and settlements; I infer that destination and authority determine the moral sign of movement. A live alternative is to treat each episode separately without making it a control on the focus verb.

changed_reading.before: Bringing people out is intrinsically liberating.
changed_reading.after: Exit becomes liberation only as an authorized trajectory away from blockage and toward stable peace; rival agents can use the same movement grammar for exile or ruin.

context_deltas.mechanism: The joined written Book is reimaged as intelligible speech that takes root, rises in branches, yields repeatedly by permission, and stabilizes hearers. The uprooted counter-word has no settled base. Extraction thus includes organic establishment, not only departure.

activation_trace.role: Joining elements into a whole anchors the Book as composed verbal material.
Intelligible utterance connecting speakers converts written composition into communicated word.
A trunked tree supplies the living architecture of the communication.
Rootedness and firmness supply durable grounding.
A high branch issuing from a root supplies expanding reach.
The yield of tree or crop supplies recurring usable output.
The focus permission recurs as the condition under which the living word bears yield.
Whole-root removal supplies the counter-mechanism of failed speech.
Stability and settlement name what the uprooted counter-word lacks.
Repeated stabilizing and strengthening show the word's effect in its receivers.

structural_cues: 14:24 directly compares a good word to a good tree with fixed root and elevated branch.
14:25 repeats the focus permission formula at recurring yield.
14:26-27 oppose uprooting without settlement to divine stabilization by stable speech.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a written Book, then a word-tree whose yield depends on the same permission; I infer that the later analogy models how the focus Book effects human change. A live alternative is that the tree comparison concerns good speech generally rather than this Book specifically.

changed_reading.before: The Book removes people from one state and places them in another.
changed_reading.after: The Book also plants an intelligible word that roots, branches, bears recurring effects, and establishes people against uprooting.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus's sent-down Book and causative human exit are materially echoed by sent-down water and the resulting emergence of fruits. Revelation becomes a descending medium that activates latent emergence through an intermediary rather than physically dragging its object.

activation_trace.role: Delivery of the Book anchors the descending medium.
Extraction from hiddenness anchors the resulting human emergence.
The repeated causative descent delivers water as a material analogue to the Book.
Water conveyed by pouring supplies the activating medium.
The repeated causative emergence makes the syntactic analogy operational.
Beneficial fruit supplies the disclosed potential brought forth.
Allocated provision makes emergence distributively useful to its recipients.

structural_cues: 14:32 repeats the focus order 'sent down ... then brought out' in one causal sentence.
The pronoun 'by it' explicitly makes water the medium of fruit emergence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies matching descent and causative-exit verbs plus an explicit water-to-fruit chain; I infer an ecological analogy for Book-to-people transformation. A live alternative is that 14:32 is an independent creation sign whose verbal parallel is not intended as a model of revelation.

changed_reading.before: The messenger extracts people by applying guidance from outside.
changed_reading.after: The sent-down Book can work like water: it reaches receptive ground and catalyzes an emergence whose fruit becomes shared provision.

context_deltas.mechanism: The Praiseworthy endpoint is independent of universal human denial, yet praise also appears as a voiced human response to gift and heard prayer. The path forms recognition and gratitude; it does not meet a lack in the one praised.

activation_trace.role: The one of many praiseworthy qualities anchors the endpoint's intrinsic worth.
Self-sufficiency removes dependence on the people's acknowledgment.
Praiseworthiness persists in direct coordination with self-sufficiency.
Spoken praise supplies the human response enacted within the surah.
A gift given without exchange supplies the occasion for praise.
Hearing supplies relational reception without by itself asserting that every request is granted.
Calling by speech supplies the human address that is heard.

structural_cues: 14:8 coordinates self-sufficiency and praiseworthiness after the possibility of universal denial.
14:39 opens with enacted praise for a gift and closes with the Lord as hearer of prayer.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies intrinsic praise beside self-sufficiency and responsive praise beside gift and hearing; I infer that the path trains recognition rather than supplying divine need. A live alternative is that the two praise occurrences make separate claims without describing the path's formative effect.

changed_reading.before: The path leads people to praise God.
changed_reading.after: It leads toward recognition of one already praiseworthy without them, while making received gift and heard address visible as reasons for their praise.

context_deltas.mechanism: Night and opened daylight are both subjected for human use. The focus movement from darkness to light can therefore describe achieved orientation and governance within changing conditions, not necessarily the annihilation of every dark interval.

activation_trace.role: Blocked conditions anchor the darkness from which orientation is needed.
Illumination anchors the directional contrast.
Subjecting and directing natural processes for a purpose supplies ordered use.
Night and its darkness remain a governed member of the pair.
Daylight opening in brightness supplies the recurring luminous counterpart.

structural_cues: 14:33 coordinates night and day under the same act of subjection.
The paired natural cycle follows the water-and-fruit sequence rather than presenting night as a defeated residue.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies jointly governed night and day; I infer that one live layer of the focus contrast concerns orientation across a cycle. A live alternative is that natural night is unrelated to the moral darknesses of 14:1, leaving the focus contrast fully absolute.

changed_reading.before: Guidance eliminates darkness and leaves only light.
changed_reading.after: Guidance may instead establish usable orientation through conditions that still alternate, bringing darkness under an ordered relation to light.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context presents full visual exposure without successful perception: eyes remain fixed, the glance cannot return, and hearts are empty air. Light must therefore include inward responsiveness and stable attention, not optical availability alone.

activation_trace.role: Illumination anchors the question of what successful seeing requires.
Heedless inattention supplies the denied possibility of unnoticed wrongdoing.
A fixed, staring gaze supplies visual exposure without flexible perception.
Eyesight supplies the literal visual faculty whose failure is dramatized.
A gaze turned or prevented from returning supplies failed visual reciprocity.
A heart weakened as though absent supplies the inner deficit.
Air and vacancy supply the heart's lack of receptive substance.

structural_cues: 14:42 denies divine inattention while deferring the wrongdoers to a day of fixed eyes.
14:43 coordinates non-returning glances with hearts described as air.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies illumination in the focus and later vision without responsive hearts; I infer that successful light requires inward reception. A live alternative is that 14:42-43 only portray terror at judgment and do not analyze the light of 14:1.

changed_reading.after: Light succeeds only when visibility becomes responsive perception and inward substance; exposed eyes can still fail to see in the needed sense.

context_deltas.mechanism: The invited, directional exit of the focus is followed by universal exposure before God, finally after earth and heavens are replaced. The first emergence can be read as an anticipatory, oriented disclosure before a later compulsory unveiling with no shelter.

context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a commissioned exit and two later scenes of universal exposure; I infer an anticipatory relation between them. A live alternative is that the verbs mark unrelated movements and should not be arranged as two modes of emergence.

changed_reading.before: The focus exit is a self-contained transition during ordinary life.
changed_reading.after: It can be read as an early, oriented emergence into disclosure before the unavoidable exposure that later overtakes everyone.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the path root's bodily swallowing branch and pairs it with a later drink that will not pass smoothly. It remains valid through the focus path branch and the packet's explicit smooth-passage branch at 14:17, but downstream prose should present it as a material lexical echo, not as a literal anatomy of the path.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus's 'path' carries a branch image of disappearance through passage or swallowing.

activation_trace.role: Swallowing and disappearance in passage make the path a conduit that receives the traveler.

changed_reading.before: The path is a line along which a person walks.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the path is also a passage that can receive and carry a traveler smoothly, contrasted with a tormenting passage that cannot be completed.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the packet resolves both light and later fire occurrences through the same root inventory, where illumination and kindled fire are neighboring branches, and the final fire covers faces. The activation is branch-resolvable and focus-anchored, but it should be rendered as a polarity internal to luminous power, never as an equation of guidance-light with punishment-fire.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus light belongs to a root inventory that includes both illumination and kindled fire.

activation_trace.role: Illumination supplies the beneficent pole of the focus destination.

changed_reading.before: Light is an uncomplicated benign opposite of darkness.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the surah keeps illumination beside fire: one discloses a path, while misdirected movement ends in luminous force that covers rather than reveals.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is a cross-domain material analogy: the Book's joining branch is set against deeds pictured as ash scattered beyond control. The contrast remains anchored in the focus's composition root and branch-backed context images, but prose should mark the anti-dispersal function as a reader-supplied analogy rather than a stated purpose of the Book.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus Book carries the image of joining separate elements into a composed whole.

changed_reading.before: The Book joins letters and statements into a text.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, its joining can also be heard as an anti-dispersal form that gives human orientation cohesion against the ash-like loss of action and agency.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it shifts the movement force from commissioned outward action to hearts inclining toward people in a barren valley. It remains anchored through the focus people and exit roots plus branch-backed heart, valley, inclination, and cultivation cues, but it should qualify attraction as a complementary activation rather than replace messenger agency.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus commissions movement of people, while 14:37 returns to people and supplies an affective direction for their hearts.

activation_trace.role: Human collectivity anchors the same social object of movement.

changed_reading.before: People are moved chiefly by an external messenger and a visible path.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, guidance can also generate affective gravity: hearts incline toward a materially barren center that becomes a site of social gathering and fruit.

strongest_changes: The darkness-to-light transfer becomes concrete collective liberation preserved by memory and gratitude.
The Book's effect becomes communicative and answerable rather than independently coercive.
The word-tree and water-fruit sequences recast extraction as rooted growth and catalyzed emergence.
Contrasting exile, entry, and settlement show that destination and authorization determine whether movement liberates.
Later failed vision and compulsory exposure deepen light from external visibility into responsive inward orientation.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet repeatedly restaged the focus syntax and roots in rival domains: political expulsion, garden entry, botanical rooting, rainfall, natural cycles, optical failure, and final exposure. Those repetitions changed the focus from a single illumination metaphor into several coexisting mechanisms of transfer, formation, reception, and tested destination.
remaining_uncertainties: The exact extent to which the Moses reprise defines, rather than exemplifies, the focus darknesses remains open.
The tree and rainfall models are strongly patterned but still depend on reading later analogies back into the opening commission.
The ordered-night reading may concern natural cycles only and need not revise the moral contrast.
The swallowing-path and light-fire activations are deliberately branch-distant and require explicit exploratory qualification.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **The book is a joined instrument that effects an authorized passage.** `ك ت ب` `B001` (joining one thing to another), `خ ر ج` `B002` (causing exit), `ء ذ ن` `B004` (authorization), and `ص ر ط` `B002` (disappearing in passage/swallowing) form a mechanism rather than a static message. The repeated later exits, roads, and changes of dwelling supply the passage structure; I infer that joined discourse becomes an authorized conduit. The ayah reads as transfer through a binding textual channel, not merely instruction about light.

2. **Light is both illumination and a stable landmark.** `ن و ر` `B001` gives illumination, while `B005` gives beacon/landmark; `ر ب ب` `B002` supplies nurture and completion. Later signs, parables, and the fixed tree supply repeated orientation. The packet gives visible markers and guided routes; the abductive move is that nurturance works by making a traversable orientation visible. *Al-nur* therefore reads as navigational stabilization as well as the opposite of darkness.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: The rooted word-tree of 14:24–27 sharpened the book as a load-bearing passage, while the water-to-fruit chain of 14:32 made “bringing out” read as productive conveyance rather than extraction alone.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **The book is an authorized operative inscription.** `ك ت ب B003` supplies inscription as binding decree, not merely `ك ت ب B002` writing/book. Its descent is grammatically directed toward causing people to exit, and 14:4-5 restage that program as messenger-language, command, and signs. The packet supplies document, mission, and purpose; I infer that the inscription binds its recipient to an enacted task. `كِتَٰبٌ` consequently reads as a mandate that is realized in guided movement.
2. **Light is also a route-marker.** Alongside `ن و ر B001` (illumination), `ن و ر B005` supplies a beacon or landmark; the verse moves from darkness to light and then immediately to `صِرَاط` (`ص ر ط B001`, straight road). The repetition of the same darkness-light extraction in 14:5 and its attachment there to visible signs (`ء ي ي B003`) supplies the orienting cues. I infer that illumination enables route recognition, so `ٱلنُّور` reads as navigational disclosure rather than brightness alone.
3. **Permission makes the Lord's care a controlled transition.** `ء ذ ن B004` supplies authorization, while `ر ب ب B002` supplies stagewise nurture and completion. The verse places authorization between extraction and destination; 14:5-6 then concretize that movement as commissioned rescue followed by remembered care. The packet gives the ordered stages, and I infer that authorization coordinates them. `بِإِذْنِ رَبِّهِمْ` therefore reads as the enabling governance of the whole passage, not a detached proviso.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 14:5 repeated the full extraction formula, and 14:6 supplied its social rescue instance. Together they corrected an initially textual reading of `كِتَاب` toward an operative mandate and sharpened `نُور` as an orienting marker.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Extraction from Cover into Light
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A written and delivered message draws people out of concealment and makes its content appear under illumination.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: written letters/book `quranic:root_001283:B002/m01`; lowering as delivery `quranic:root_001492:B002/m01`; extraction from concealment `quranic:root_000400:B002/m01`; disappearance under cover `quranic:root_000913:B002/m01`; blocking or concealing truth `quranic:root_001307:B003/m01`; illumination `quranic:root_001564:B001/m01`; appearance and disclosure `quranic:root_000170:B004/m01`.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.ayah_anchors: 14:1-5: كِتَابٌ، أَنزَلْنَاهُ، لِتُخْرِجَ، الظُّلُمَاتِ، النُّورِ، الْكَافِرِينَ، ضَلَالٍ، لِيُبَيِّنَ، أَخْرِجْ.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The message is not only information. Its lexical scene is a transfer that reaches a covered location, removes its occupants, and places both people and meaning in light. Concealment, denial, and straying are therefore spatial resistance to disclosure.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.ayah_anchors: 14:1-3, 9, 12: النُّورِ، صِرَاطِ، يَصُدُّونَ عَنْ سَبِيلِ، يَبْغُونَهَا عِوَجًا، ضَلَالٍ، يَأْتِكُمْ، نَبَؤُا، هَدَانَا سُبُلَنَا.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Guidance is staged as practical orientation: a straight, extended, conspicuous route with a beacon and even access to water. The opposing operations are not one generic error but blockage, imposed curvature, and loss of bearing.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, anlam çekirdeğini bir şeyi başka bir şeye katıp birleştirmek olarak açıkça kurar; deri dikme, hayvanın bazı uzuvlarını bağlama, boncukla tutturma ve birlik oluşturma kullanımları da bu çekirdeğin özelleşmiş gerçekleşmeleridir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, yazı yazma ya da hüküm verme anlamını değil, fiziksel veya toplu birleştirme işlemini kapsar.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım ortak birleştirme çekirdeğini korur; dikme, bağlama, kapatma ve birlik düzenleme anlamlarını yalnızca tanıklanmış biçim ve yapılara bağlı özelleşmeler olarak verir.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi başka bir şeye katıp aralarında fiziksel ya da topluluk oluşturan bir bağ kurmaktır. Derileri dikme, açıklıkları bağlama veya kapatma ve insan ya da atları düzenli bir birlik hâline getirme bunun yapıya bağlı gerçekleşmeleridir.

facets.statement: Temel işlem, bir şeyi başka bir şeye katarak ikisini bir bütün veya bağlı bir düzen içinde birleştirmektir.
Deri parçalarını ya da bir su tulumunu dikişle birleştirmek, çekirdeğin el işi alanındaki özel gerçekleşmesidir.
Bir hayvanın belirli uzuvlarını halka, kayış veya iple birbirine bağlamak ve bir kabın ağzını sıkıca kapatmak yapıya bağlı kullanımlardır.
Atların veya askerlerin toplanıp ayrı ve düzenli bir birlik oluşturması, fiziksel birleştirmeden topluluk düzenine uzanan anlamdır.
Kayışın iki yüzünü bir arada tutan boncuk, ortaya çıkan bağın somut bir örneğidir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak çizgisi, katma ve birleştirme çekirdeğinin dikiş, bağlama, sıkıca kapatma ve düzenli topluluk oluşturma gibi somut uygulamalarda korunmasıdır.

concept_map.definition: Harfleri çizgiyle düzenleyerek yazılı bir metin oluşturmak ve bu işlemin ürünü olan metin ya da yazılı sayfadır. Birine yazdırma, ondan yazmasını isteme ve yazmayı öğretme ise belirli yapılara bağlı uzantılardır.

facets.statement: Temel işlem, harfleri yazıyla düzenleyip bir metin oluşturmak veya var olan metni kopyalamaktır.
İşlemin ürünü, yazılmış metin veya üzerinde bu metnin bulunduğu sayfa ya da kitaptır.
Bir metni başkasına söyleyerek yazdırmak ve birinden kendisi için yazmasını istemek yapıya bağlı ettirgen ve isteme kullanımlarıdır.
Yazmayı öğretmek, yazı öğretmeni ve öğretim yeri anlamları yazı edinimi alanındaki bağlı kullanımlardır.
Öğretim yerindeki çocuklar veya onların topluluğu için kullanılan biçim, yeri değil öğrencileri gösterir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar yazmayı harfleri çizgiyle bir araya getiren işlem olarak sunar; yazılı ürün, kopyalama, dikte ettirme, yazma isteği ve öğretimle ilgili kullanımlar bu merkeze bağlanır.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه كتب الكتاب وكتابته ونسخه، والكتاب اسما للمكتوب أو الصحيفة ذات الكتابة، والتعليم والإملاء والاستكتاب المتعلق بالكتابة.
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس المراد هنا الفرض والحكم والقدر إلا إذا صارت الكتابة كناية عن الإيجاب أو الإثبات، ولا يدخل فيه سهم الصبيان الصغير.
branches.source_phrase_ar: الكتاب والكتابة يقال كتبت الكتاب أكتبه كتبا (maqayis)؛ وقد كتب الكتاب يكتبه كتبا إذا جمع حروفه (jamhara)؛ الكتاب معروف وقد كتبت كتبا وكتابا وكتابة (sihah)؛ كتبت الكتاب كتبا وكتابا فالكتاب اسم لما كتب مجموعا (tahdhib)؛ في التعارف ضم الحروف بعضها إلى بعض بالخط (mufradat)؛ أكتبني هذه القصيدة أي أملها علي (sihah)؛ استكتبه الشيء أي سأله أن يكتبه له (sihah;tahdhib)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, bir şeyi yükümlülük, hüküm, paylaştırılmış yazgı veya kesinleşmiş karar olarak belirleme alanını açıkça toplar; burada yazı, harf çizme eylemi değil bağlayıcı biçimde belirlemenin anlatım yoludur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Salt yazı yazmak bu dala girmez; belirleme işleminin yükümlülük, hüküm veya yazgı sonucu doğurması gerekir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yükümlülük, hüküm ve yazgı değerleri birlikte korunur; birine zorunluluk yükleme ve Tanrı'nın belirlemesi anlamları yalnızca tanıklanmış yapılara bağlanır.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi bağlayıcı bir yükümlülük, hüküm veya gerçekleşmesi belirlenmiş pay ve yazgı olarak karara bağlamaktır. Yazma çağrışımı burada harf çizmekten çok kararın kesinleştirilip geçerli kılınmasını anlatır.

facets.statement: Bir işi yapılması gereken bağlayıcı bir yükümlülük olarak belirlemek temel değerlerden biridir.
Bir konuda geçerli ve kesinleşmiş hüküm vermek aynı belirleme çekirdeğinin yargısal yönüdür.
Bir olayın payını, ölçüsünü veya gelecekte gerçekleşecek sonucunu önceden belirlemek yazgı yönünü oluşturur.
Yazma anlatımı, belirlenen hükmün saptanmış, yürürlüğe konmuş ve kesinleşmiş olmasını ifade eder.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar yükümlülük, hüküm, yazgı, belirleme ve kesinleşmiş karar değerlerini aynı bağlayıcı saptama alanında birleştirir; yazma sözü bu saptamanın anlatım aracıdır.

concept_gloss.text: bağlayıcı olarak hükme bağlama ve belirleme
concept_gloss.applicability: Yükümlülük, hüküm ve yazgı yönlerini tek bir kesin ve geçerli belirleme çekirdeğinde toplar.

error_profile.preserves: Bağlayıcılık, karar verme ve önceden belirleme yönlerinin tümünü korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir eylemin kişilere bağlayıcı yükümlülük olarak yüklendiği bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Yapılması gereken işi bağlayıcı yükümlülük hâline getirme anlamını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir olayın gerçekleşmesini veya kişiye düşecek payı önceden belirleme bağlamlarında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Gelecekteki olay veya payın önceden karara bağlanması anlamını korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: Tanrı belirledi, karara bağladı veya zorunlu kıldı

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal, zorunluluk ve kesin hükmün yanında pay veya yazgıyı önceden belirlemeyi de kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal, kararın kaçınılmazlığına, sıkıca kesinleştirilmesine ve kişiye yüklenmesine özellikle yoğunlaşır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da bir kararın kesin, geçerli ve bağlayıcı hâle getirilmesi alanında güçlü biçimde örtüşür.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu dal kaçınılmaz kesin hükmü merkez alır; odak dal ise aynı ekseni yükümlülük ve yazgı belirleme yönlerine de açar.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal, yükümlülüğe ek olarak hüküm ve önceden belirlenmiş yazgı anlamlarını taşır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal, özellikle yerine getirilmesi gereken ödev ve vazgeçilmez hak türlerini öne çıkarır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal yapılması gereken işi bağlayıcı bir yükümlülük olarak gösterir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Yükümlülük bağlamında yaklaşırlar; ancak odak dalın hüküm ve yazgı kapsamı komşuda yoktur, komşunun ödev ve hak odağı da daha dardır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal, hükmün yanında yükümlülük koyma ve olayları önceden belirleme yönlerini içerir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal, taraflar arasında karar verme ve uyuşmazlığı kesin biçimde sonuçlandırma işlemini kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal, bir meseleyi geçerli ve kesin bir kararla sonuçlandırma alanında buluşur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu dal yargılama ve uyuşmazlığı ayırma eylemine dayanır; odak dalda ise bağlayıcı belirleme daha geniş olup bir uyuşmazlık gerektirmez.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün aday komşular değerlendirildi; seçilenler zorunluluk, kesin hüküm ve karar verme sınırlarındaki gerçek örtüşmeleri gösterir, diğerleri yalnızca kanıt, izin veya konu ortaklığı düzeyinde kalır.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الكتاب بمعنى الفرض والحكم والقدر، والكتابة بمعنى الإثبات والتقدير والإيجاب والعزم والقضاء الممضى.

branches.source_phrase_ar: الكتاب وهو الفرض (maqayis)؛ يقال للحكم الكتاب (maqayis)؛ يقال للقدر الكتاب (maqayis)؛ الكتاب الفرض والحكم والقدر (sihah)؛ الكتاب يوضع موضع الفرض (tahdhib)؛ يعبر عن الإثبات والتقدير والإيجاب والفرض والعزم بالكتابة (mufradat)؛ يعبر بالكتابة عن القضاء الممضى (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, bir kişinin adını pay veya geçim kaydına ya da yönetim siciline geçirmek ile kişiyi tanıklar topluluğuna dâhil etmek arasında ortak bir kayıt ve üyelik çekirdeği kurar.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, genel yazma eylemini değil, adı kayda geçirerek kişiyi bir listeye veya belirli topluluğa dâhil etmeyi anlatır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Sicile alma ve topluluğa katma çekirdeği korunur; pay kaydı, yönetim sicili ve tanıklar arasına katılma anlamları kendi tanıklanmış yapılarıyla sınırlıdır.

concept_map.definition: Bir kişinin adını resmî bir pay, geçim veya yönetim kaydına geçirerek onu kayıtlılar arasına almak ya da kişiyi belirli bir topluluğun üyesi saymaktır.

facets.statement: Kişinin adını bir kayıt veya listeye geçirerek ona kayıtlı kişi konumu vermek dalın çekirdeğidir.
Adı pay, geçim tahsisatı veya yönetim siciline yazdırmak resmî kayıt alanındaki özel gerçekleşmedir.
Bir kişiyi tanıklar gibi belirli bir topluluğun içinde saymak, sicile almadan üyelik vermeye uzanan kullanımdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak içeriği, adı kayda geçirmenin kişiyi pay alanlar, yönetim sicilindekiler veya belirli bir topluluğun üyeleri arasına sokmasıdır.

concept_gloss.text: adını sicile yazma veya bir gruba dâhil etme
concept_gloss.applicability: Hem resmî sicile alma hem de kişiyi belirli bir topluluğun üyesi sayma anlamlarını kapsar.

error_profile.preserves: Adı sicile yazma veya kişiye belirli bir topluluk içinde üyelik verme işlemlerini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kişinin pay, geçim tahsisatı veya yönetim kaydına kendi adını geçirdiği bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Kişinin adını resmî kayda geçirerek kayıtlı konum kazanması anlamını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişinin tanıklar gibi adı belirli bir topluluğun üyesi sayıldığı bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Kişiye belirli topluluk içinde üyelik ve yer verilmesi anlamını korur.

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal, ad kaydı olmadan nesneleri fiziksel olarak veya insanları düzenli topluluk olarak birleştirir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal, ayrı bir kişiyi veya unsuru daha büyük bir bütünün içine katma düşüncesinde buluşur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalın ayırıcı özelliği adın kayda geçirilmesi veya üyelik verilmesidir; komşu dalda kayıt koşulu bulunmaz ve birleştirme kendi başına çekirdektir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal, kişiyi adını kaydederek bir sicile veya topluluğa dâhil etme işlemini anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal, bir şeyin belirli kişi veya topluluğa özel olmasını ve başkalarından ayrılmasını anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal kişi veya şeyin belirli bir toplulukla ilişkili konum kazanması alanındadır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal katılma ve kayıt işlemini, komşu dal ise başkalarına kapalı özel aidiyet ve ayrışma durumunu merkez alır.

branches.branch_image_ar: إدخال الاسم في سجل أو زمرة
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الاكتتاب في الفرض والرزق، وكتابة الاسم في ديوان السلطان، ومعنى اجعلنا في زمرة الشاهدين.
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس هو مجرد تأليف كتاب، ولا حكم الفرض نفسه، بل إدخال اسم أو شخص في سجل أو جماعة.
branches.source_phrase_ar: الكتبة الاكتتاب في الفرض والرزق (ayn;tahdhib)؛ اكتتب فلان أي كتب اسمه في الفرض (ayn;tahdhib)؛ اكتتب الرجل إذا كتب نفسه في ديوان السلطان (sihah)؛ فاكتبنا مع الشاهدين أي اجعلنا في زمرتهم (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, köleleştirilmiş kişinin kendi özgürlük bedelini kazancından ve belirlenmiş ödemelerle karşılaması için sahibiyle yaptığı özel sözleşmeyi, taraflarını ve özgürleşme sonucunu açıkça tanımlar.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, her türlü yazılı sözleşmeyi değil, bedelin ödenmesiyle özgürlüğe götüren bu özel sözleşme türünü kapsar.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım özel sözleşme türüne bağlı kalır; sözleşmenin adı, tarafı ve sözleşme yapma eylemi ayrı tanıklanmış biçimler olarak korunur ve genel sözleşme anlamına genişletilmez.

concept_map.definition: Köleleştirilmiş kişinin, belirlenen bedeli kazancından ve kararlaştırılmış ödemelerle sahibine vererek özgürlüğünü kazanması için taraflar arasında yapılan özel sözleşmedir. Bedel tamamlandığında kişi özgür olur.

facets.statement: Sahip ile köleleştirilmiş kişi arasında, kişinin kendi özgürlük bedelini ödemesini konu alan özel bir sözleşme kurulur.
Bedel belirlenmiş ödeme dilimlerine bağlanır ve köleleştirilmiş kişi bunu kendi kazancından karşılar.
Kararlaştırılan bedelin tamamlanması sözleşmenin sonucu olarak köleleştirilmiş kişinin özgür olmasını sağlar.
İlgili biçimler sözleşmenin kendisini, sözleşmeye bağlı köleleştirilmiş kişiyi ve bağlama göre sözleşmenin öteki tarafını gösterebilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, özgürlük bedelinin kararlaştırılıp ödemelere bölündüğü, köleleştirilmiş kişinin bunu kazancıyla ödediği ve tamamlandığında özgürleştiği özel sözleşmede birleşir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Sözleşmenin taraflarını, ödeme düzenini ve bedelin tamamlanmasıyla doğan özgürleşme sonucunu birlikte kapsar.

error_profile.preserves: Özel sözleşme türünü, bedel ödeme koşulunu ve özgürleşme sonucunu eksiksiz korur.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, yukarıdan aşağı inmeyi, araçtan inmeyi, yağmurun düşmesini, bir yerde konaklamayı ve ağır ağır inmeyi birlikte açıkça destekler. Verilen dal çerçevesi bu hareket ve yerleşme alanını doğru biçimde toplar.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Temel iniş ile bir yerde konaklama birlikte korunmalı; ettirgen indirme, konuk ağırlama ve savaş kullanımları bu dala katılmamalıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Dal hem yalın iniş biçimlerini hem de yağmurun yağması ve bir yerde konaklama gibi yapıya bağlı kullanımları içerir; bu özel kullanımlar bütün dala genellenmez.

concept_map.definition: Bir varlığın yukarıdan aşağı doğru hareket etmesi ya da bulunduğu araçtan ayrılmasıdır; ayrıca bir yere varıp yükünü bırakarak orada konaklamayı kapsar. Hareket yağmurun düşmesi gibi gerçekleşebilir ve ağır ağır ilerleyebilir.

facets.statement: Bir şey yukarıdan aşağı hareket eder veya üzerinde bulunduğu araçtan ayrılır.
Hareket, bir yere varıp yükünü bırakarak orada konaklama sonucuna uzanır.
Yağmurun gökten düşmesi, aşağı yönlü hareketin doğal bir örneğidir.
İniş, bir anda değil ağır ağır ve aşamalı biçimde gerçekleşebilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak anlatım, aşağı yönlü hareketi dalın çekirdeği sayar; araçtan ayrılmayı, yağmurun düşmesini, bir yerde yük indirip konaklamayı ve ağır ilerleyen inişi bu çekirdeğin gerçekleşmeleri olarak verir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi genel olarak herhangi bir şeyi indirmekten çok, Tanrı'nın iyilikleri ve sıkıntıları kullara vermesini, bildiriyi ulaştırmasını, kimi zaman sonucun kendisi yerine nedenlerini göndermesini ve bildirinin bölüm bölüm yinelenmesini anlatır. Bu yüzden dal, genel ettirgen indirme yerine bu özel ulaştırma çerçevesiyle tanımlanmalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Tanrısal verme ve bildirme çekirdeği korunmalı; sıradan fiziksel indirme yalnızca ayrı sözcük biriminin karşılığı olarak kalmalıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Dal, genel ettirgen biçimlerin yanında Tanrı'nın verme ve bildirme eylemlerine bağlı özel yapıları içerir; özel dinsel kapsam yalın biçimin her kullanımına taşınmaz.

concept_map.definition: Tanrı'nın iyilikleri, cezaları, esirgemeyi veya bir bildiriyi insanlara ulaştırmasıdır; ulaştırma doğrudan şeyin kendisiyle ya da onu doğuran nedenlerin verilmesiyle gerçekleşebilir. Bildiri bölüm bölüm ve yinelenerek gelebilir.

facets.statement: Tanrı iyilikleri veya cezaları insanlara verir ve ulaştırır.
Ulaştırma, şeyin kendisinin gelmesiyle ya da onu ortaya çıkaran nedenlerin gönderilmesiyle olabilir.
Tanrısal bildiri bölüm bölüm ve tekrar tekrar ulaştırılabilir.
Tanrısal esirgemenin bir topluluğa erişmesi bu ulaştırma biçiminin örneğidir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak içerik, Tanrı'nın yarar ve sıkıntıları insanlara vermesini doğrudan nesnenin ya da nedenlerinin ulaştırılmasıyla açıklar; tanrısal bildirinin bölüm bölüm yinelenmesi ve esirgemenin erişmesi de bu çerçevededir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi konaklanan yer, su başı ve ev anlamlarını; soyut olarak dereceyi; ayrıca insanları konak yerlerine yerleştirme ve birini derecesinden düşürme eylemlerini açıkça bir araya getirir. Verilen dal çerçevesi bu yer ve derece uzantılarını doğru yansıtır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Yer veya derece sonucu merkezdedir; sırf aşağı hareket etme ve konuğa yiyecek hazırlama bu dala girmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın yer ve derece adları ile insanları konak yerlerine yerleştiren yapıya bağlı eylemler ayrılır; yerleştirme kullanımı bütün yalın biçimlere yayılmaz.

concept_map.definition: İnsanların indiği ve kaldığı ev, durak ya da su başı gibi bir yerdir; soyut uzantıda kişinin veya şeyin bulunduğu dereceyi anlatır. İnsanlar bu yerlere yerleştirilebilir, bir kişinin derecesi de aşağı çekilebilir.

facets.statement: İnilen ve kalınan yer, ev, durak veya su başı olarak adlandırılır.
Somut yer düşüncesi, kişinin ya da şeyin bulunduğu dereceye aktarılır.
Bir topluluk, kendisi için belirlenen konak yerlerine yerleştirilebilir.
Bir kimsenin bulunduğu derece aşağı çekilebilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak alanı konaklanan yeri ev ve su başına kadar genişletir, buradan soyut derece anlamına geçer; topluluğa konak yeri belirleme ve kişiyi derecesinden düşürme de bu iki alanın eylem biçimleridir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi konuğa hazırlanan yiyecek ve yol azığını çekirdek yapar; konuğun kendisini, ürün gelirini, fazlalığı, bağışı ve birikmiş payı buna bağlı kullanımlar olarak açıkça verir. Verilen dal çerçevesi çekirdeği ve benzetmeli uzantıları doğru ayırmaya elverişlidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Konuk için hazırlanan pay çekirdektir; yer, derece ve savaş anlamları dışarıda, gelir ve bağış anlamları ise bağlı uzantı olarak tutulmalıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın yiyecek, pay, gelir ve konuk adları ile konuk etme ve bolluk bildiren yapılar ayrı ayrı korunur; yapıya bağlı bolluk anlamı bütün dala yayılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir konuğun geldiğinde yararlanması için önceden hazırlanan yiyecek, yol azığı ve ağırlama payıdır. Bu çekirdekten konuğun kendisi, ürün geliri, fazlalık, bağış ve bir araya gelmiş pay anlamları gelişir.

facets.statement: Konuğun yararlanması için yiyecek, yol azığı ve ağırlama payı hazırlanır.
Hazırlanan payla ilişkili olarak konuk kişinin kendisi de adlandırılır.
Hazır pay düşüncesi ürün geliri, fazlalık, bereket ve bağış anlamlarına uzanır.
Bir araya toplanmış pay, konuk için hazırlanmış toplu yiyeceğe benzetilerek anlatılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak anlatım konuğa hazırlanan yiyecek, azık ve ağırlamayı temel alır; konuk adı, ürün geliri ve fazlalığı, bol verme, topluluğun geçim payları ve birikmiş pay bu hazırlık düşüncesinden gelişir.

concept_gloss.text: konuk için hazırlanan yiyecek ve ağırlama payı
concept_gloss.applicability: Dalın konuğu karşılamak üzere önceden hazırlanan temel payını anlatmak için kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Konuğu, önceden hazırlığı, yiyeceği ve ağırlama payını birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Konuğa sunulmak üzere hazırlanmış yiyecek veya azık anlatılırken kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Hazırlanmış yiyecek ile konuğa yönelen ağırlama amacını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Yetiştirilen şeyin getirisi, bereketi veya artan payı anlatılırken kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Hazır pay düşüncesinden gelişen gelir ve fazlalık uzantısını korur.
error_profile.loses: Konuk için yiyecek hazırlama ve konuğun kendisi anlamlarını dışarıda bırakır.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Dağınık olmayan, bir araya toplanmış bir hak veya pay anlatılırken kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Payın bir araya gelmiş ve hazır durumda bulunmasını korur.
error_profile.loses: Konuğa sunma amacını ve ürün geliri uzantısını belirtmez.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: konuğa hazırlanan yiyecek veya yol azığı
bol veren ve eli açık olan

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal genel hazırlık ve paydır; komşu dal bunun içindeki belirli, küçük bir ikram türüdür.
